_readme: CIVILIZATION LIVERY — the base material each fleet is built from, and the two accent colours
the player may change.
The texture Meshy returns is a single baked image with no layers, so the only way to know which
pixels are 'the stripe' and which are 'the hull' is to key them by colour. Keying only works if
an accent hue appears nowhere else — a teal stripe on a teal hull is unrecoverable.
REVISED after the first pass came back looking white. The original rule was 'base desaturated,
accents saturated', which keys perfectly and produced a fleet of pale ships: pearl-white nacre,
pale ice, bone wood. When the accents then failed to land there was no colour left at all, and
the civilizations were indistinguishable. Identity cannot live entirely in trim that might not
arrive.
So there are now TWO kinds of civ, flagged by `baseSaturated`:
baseSaturated: false  (Terran, Pyrothian) — the hull is genuinely neutral: steel grey-blue,
charcoal basalt. It sits below maskRules.minSaturation, so it cannot be mistaken for an
accent no matter what hue it leans toward, and only the two accents need separating.
baseSaturated: true  (Aquarii, Cryithn, Sylvan) — the hull carries the civ's signature colour
outright: deep sea-teal, glacier-blue, forest-green. Those ships read as themselves across
the map with no accents at all. The cost is that `baseHue` now competes for hue space, so
THREE things must stay apart, not two — which is why these civs' accents were moved off the
signature colour entirely (Aquarii teal hull, amber and magenta livery).
hueSeparation is a check, not decoration: below about 60 degrees two masks bleed into each other
and the secondary stops being independently recolourable. For a saturated base, mind the distance
from baseHue to BOTH accents as well as between them.
primary/secondary are DEFAULTS. They are what ships in the texture and what a new game starts
with; the player overrides them per civilization and the shader recolours the masked regions.
keyHue/keySat are what the offline mask extractor matches on (tools/extract-color-masks.mjs).
Widen keyTolerance only if a civ's mask comes out patchy; narrow it if the mask bleeds onto hull.

maskRules._note: HSV. A pixel joins a mask when its saturation and value clear the floors AND its hue is within keyTolerance degrees of that accent's keyHue. Everything else stays unrecoloured base.

Terran.baseMaterial: mid-tone STEEL GREY-BLUE gunmetal plating, black heat radiators, exposed structural ribs - a definite colour, never white

primary.name: Cobalt
primary.role: hull stripes, wing flashes, the broad livery panels

secondary.name: Safety Orange
secondary.role: trim lines, hazard chevrons, running lights, engine glow

Terran.signature: Weathered service ship: scuffed paint, panel wear, soot around the thrusters.

Aquarii.baseMaterial: a CYBORG SEA CREATURE - deep sea-teal scaled skin, fin membranes and ribbed cartilage, with hard metal armour plates bolted over the back and flanks, mechanical gill vents, cybernetic lens eyes, cable bundles and glowing implant seams

primary.name: Amber
primary.role: the armour plates over the back, flanks and dorsal fin

secondary.name: Magenta
secondary.role: glowing implant seams, fin edges, lens eyes and gill slits

Aquarii.baseShort: deep sea-teal cyborg sea-creature hull with scaled skin and fins
Aquarii.signature: Living hull: wet scaled skin and fin membranes under bolted armour, glowing implant seams.

Pyrothian.baseMaterial: jagged BLACK IRON and obsidian plate, riveted and barbed, scorched and ash-stained, lit from within by furnace fire

primary.name: Forge Fire
primary.role: the molten cracks in the plate and the furnace mouths

Pyrothian.signature: JAGGED AND BARBED, lit from WITHIN by molten fire through every crack. Ash, smoke, forge-glare.

Cryithn.baseMaterial: RICHLY COLOURED deep glacier-blue faceted armour over frosted silver alloy, rime-crusted plating

primary.name: Aurora Violet
primary.role: the faceted panel inlays and dorsal spine

secondary.name: Ember Gold
secondary.role: crystal spine tips, drive glow, instrument light

Cryithn.signature: FROZEN: rime and frost crusting the plates, ice crystal along every seam, cold vapour off the drives, mirror facets.

Sylvan.baseMaterial: RICHLY COLOURED deep forest-green living hull, woven vine over a seed-pod shell, dark bark plating

primary.name: Blossom Violet
primary.role: the broad leaf-sail and canopy panels

secondary.name: Sap Amber
secondary.role: sap-light veins along the grain, blossoms, pod seams

Sylvan.signature: GROWN, NOT BUILT: bark plating, vine over a seed-pod shell, moss in the seams, living wood grain.

_signatureNote: signature: the surface condition every hull of this civ must show, sent in the prompt right after the hull description and before the tier clause. It exists because without it a fire civ and an ice civ came back as the same grey ship with a different accent colour.
